meals.recipe: Prepare cappuccino: Froth oat milk and pour over espresso shot. Toast bread slices. Spread peanut butter on toast slices and top with jam.

Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss broccoli and bell pepper with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 15-20 minutes. Season salmon fillet, drizzle with remaining olive oil, and bake or grill until cooked through (approx. 12-15 minutes). Serve grilled salmon with roasted vegetables and cooked quinoa.
Slice banana. Combine plant-based yogurt, sliced banana, and walnuts in a bowl.

Slice chicken breast and vegetables. Heat olive oil in a wok or large pan. Stir-fry chicken until cooked. Add onions and carrots, stir-fry for a few minutes. Add spinach and soy sauce, cook until spinach wilts. Serve stir-fry over cooked brown rice.
Prepare cappuccino: Froth oat milk and pour over espresso shot. Toast bread slices. Spread peanut butter on toast slices and top with jam.

Sauté chopped onion, carrot, and celery in a pot. Add dry lentils, shredded chicken, and vegetable broth/water. Simmer until lentils are tender (approx. 30-40 minutes). Season to taste. Serve soup hot with whole wheat bread, drizzled with olive oil.
Slice cucumber and bell pepper into sticks. Serve hummus with vegetable sticks, olives, and whole grain crackers.

Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut sweet potatoes into chunks, toss with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes. Add asparagus and cod fillet (seasoned and drizzled with remaining oil) to the baking sheet. Roast for another 12-15 minutes, until fish is cooked and vegetables are tender. Squeeze lemon juice over before serving if desired.
Prepare cappuccino: Froth oat milk and pour over espresso shot. Toast bread slices. Spread peanut butter on toast slices and top with jam.

Grill or pan-sear chicken breast until cooked, then slice. Chop cucumber, tomato, red onion, and bell pepper. Combine chopped vegetables and olives in a bowl. Add sliced chicken. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice (optional). Serve with warm whole wheat pita bread.
Slice the pear. Combine pear slices, walnuts, and plant-based yogurt.

Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté chopped carrots and cauliflower until slightly tender. Add chickpeas, peas, curry powder/paste (to taste), and lite coconut milk. Simmer for 10-15 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted. Serve curry over cooked brown rice.
Prepare cappuccino: Froth oat milk and pour over espresso shot. Toast bread slices. Spread peanut butter on toast slices and top with jam.

Chop celery finely. Mix drained tuna, lactose-free mayonnaise, and chopped celery. Spread tuna mixture on whole wheat bread slices to make a sandwich. Prepare side salad: combine mixed greens, sliced cucumber, and tomato. Whisk olive oil with lemon juice/vinegar (optional) for dressing and toss with salad. Serve sandwich with side salad.
Peel and segment orange. Slice banana. Combine plant-based yogurt, chia seeds, orange segments, banana slices, and mixed nuts in a bowl.

Grill or pan-sear turkey breast until cooked through. Chop eggplant, zucchini, and tomato. Sauté vegetables in olive oil until tender (Ratatouille style). Season to taste. Bake or boil potato until tender. Serve grilled turkey with cooked bulgur wheat, ratatouille, and baked potato.
Prepare cappuccino: Froth oat milk and pour over espresso shot. Toast bread slices. Spread peanut butter on toast slices and top with jam.

Grill or bake salmon fillet until cooked, then flake or slice. Combine mixed greens, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and sliced bell pepper in a bowl. Top with salmon. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice/vinegar (optional). Serve with whole grain crackers.
Slice apple. Combine plant-based yogurt, mixed berries, and pumpkin seeds. Serve with apple slices.

Cook whole wheat pasta according to package directions. While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a pan. Sauté chopped onion until softened. Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up. Drain excess fat if necessary. Stir in tomato sauce and herbs (e.g., basil, oregano). Simmer for 10-15 minutes. Serve sauce over cooked pasta.
Prepare cappuccino: Froth oat milk and pour over espresso shot. Toast bread slices. Spread peanut butter on toast slices and top with jam.

Grill or pan-sear shrimp until pink and cooked through. Combine mixed greens, sliced cucumber, tomato, and red onion in a large bowl. Top salad with cooked shrimp. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice (optional). Serve with a side of cooked lentils.
Peel and eat the orange.

Preheat oven according to pizza base instructions. Cook chicken breast and slice/shred. Slice vegetables. Spread tomato sauce on pizza base. Top with cooked chicken, vegetables, and lactose-free mozzarella cheese. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake until crust is golden and cheese is melted.
Prepare cappuccino: Froth oat milk and pour over espresso shot. Toast bread slices. Spread peanut butter on toast slices and top with jam.

Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Chop zucchini, eggplant, and bell pepper. Toss vegetables with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 20-25 minutes until tender. Season chicken breast, drizzle with remaining olive oil, and bake or grill until cooked through. Serve chicken with roasted vegetables and cooked quinoa.
Slice apple. Serve apple slices with peanut butter for dipping and a side of whole grain crackers.

ingredients.name: white beans (cooked, e.g., navy or cannellini)

meals.recipe: Heat olive oil in a pot. Sauté chopped onion, carrot, and celery until softened. Add cooked white beans, chopped kale, and vegetable broth/water. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until kale is tender. Season to taste with salt, pepper, and herbs. Serve hot with crusty whole wheat bread.
